title: Option cash flows and put–call parity
objectives: Derive all four elementary option payoffs and funded profit thresholds
Distinguish moneyness, immediate-exercise amount and a European option's price
Prove European put–call parity through statewise and dated cash-flow identities
Construct parity arbitrage ledgers and incorporate known dividends and execution frictions
prerequisites: Dated cash-flow conventions, short selling and no-arbitrage from chapters 01–02; discount factors from chapter 08.
source_scope: Full English captions for positions 31 and 61 read sequentially. Position61 is the official put–call-parity lecture placed after basic options in the course catalog. Original finite constructions supplement the source; exercise, funding, and stock-domain assumptions are explicit.
